method.name: advance
method.description: Advances the clock by [param delta] seconds, recomputes the sun and moon, and republishes to [WeatherBus]. Happens automatically each frame unless [member paused] is set; call it directly to step deterministically.

method.name: get_moon_direction
method.description: Unit vector pointing [b]toward[/b] the moon. Currently the anti-sun, which is not astronomically true but does light the night sky.

method.name: get_sun_direction
method.description: Unit vector pointing [b]toward[/b] the sun, in world space. Same value and convention as [member WeatherBus.tod_sun_direction].

method.name: get_sun_intensity
method.description: Sun intensity from the last solve. About [code]0.5[/code] with the sun on the horizon, reaching [code]0.0[/code] roughly 2.9° below it. Used for the sun light's energy when [member sun_energy_curve] is unset.

method.name: is_active_producer
method.description: Whether this node is the one driving [WeatherBus]. The first [TimeOfDay] to enter the tree claims it; a later one warns and leaves the bus alone, since two producers writing the same values every frame would only flicker.
